'''Fairy Stone''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Frozen Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Bundles==
Fairy Stone is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Fairy Stone is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Fairy Stone is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt070.png|24px]]
It is a purple dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the purple dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in dyeing.

==Quests==
Fairy Stone is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].
